# Ecomblade

Ecomblade is a global product-research platform for ecommerce sellers. It helps users compare sales volume, revenue, pricing, ratings, and demand across Shopee, TikTok Shop, Lazada, Amazon, Temu, and Alibaba.

## Main pages

- [Homepage](https://ecomblade.com/): Product features, workflow, pricing, and frequently asked questions.
- [About](https://ecomblade.com/about/): The company mission and product principles.
- [Contact](https://ecomblade.com/contact/): Support, billing, data, and partnership contact options.
- [Privacy Policy](https://ecomblade.com/privacy/): Information collection, use, and protection practices.
- [Terms and Conditions](https://ecomblade.com/terms/): Terms governing use of the website and platform.

## Product access

- [Create an account](https://app.ecomblade.com/register)
- [Log in](https://app.ecomblade.com/login)
